question: What exact edge-level empirical-measure shift, sharp bounded-statistic envelope, concentration change and maximum edge-mass inflation are implied by the already-published root-to-leaf edge-multiplicity histogram?

design_timing.interpretation: This artifact verifies a deterministic analytic corollary of already-published aggregates. It is not a preregistered independent empirical finding.

fixed_empirical_measures.canonical: p_e = 1 / E for each of E distinct observed child-parent edges
fixed_empirical_measures.path_linearized: q_e = m_e / M where m_e is the number of root-to-leaf path occurrences of edge e and M = sum_e m_e
fixed_empirical_measures.inverse_multiplicity_corrected: each path occurrence of edge e has unnormalized mass 1 / m_e, then the total mass is normalized by E

exact_derivations.bounded_statistic_envelope: sup over all f:E->[0,1] of |E_q[f]-E_p[f]| = TV(p,q)
exact_derivations.corrected_measure_identity: for every edge e, sum over its m_e occurrences of (1/m_e) = 1; normalized corrected edge mass equals 1/E

required_cross_checks: the two fixed receipts have the required classifications and snapshot
E, M, duplicate count and the full multiplicity histogram match across receipts
histogram counts sum to E and multiplicity-weighted counts sum to M
all exact values are represented as reduced integer numerator and denominator
the maximizing-set identity equals the independently summed total variation exactly
inverse-multiplicity correction returns zero exact total variation from canonical
producer A/B and a non-importing independent verifier are byte-identical

claim_boundary.allowed: For the two fixed empirical edge measures induced by the published MLE-agent observed forest, root-to-leaf path linearization has the exact reported total variation and concentration shift; this total variation is the sharp worst-case shift over arbitrary bounded edge-level statistics, while inverse-multiplicity occurrence weights exactly recover the canonical edge measure.

failure_rule: Any input hash, classification, snapshot, histogram reconciliation, integer accounting, exact rational identity, source, security or independent-verification mismatch fails closed. Exploratory values are disclosed and may not be presented as preregistered or independently confirmed.
